camel_example: aliyun ossutil api put-bucket-referer --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou
description_en: Configures the hotlink protection (Referer) whitelist at the bucket level. You can specify whether to allow requests with an empty Referer field and whether to allow requests with a truncated query string to access OSS
description_zh: 设置存储空间（Bucket）级别的防盗链（Referer）访问白名单，支持设置是否允许Referer字段为空以及是否允许截断QueryString的请求访问OSS
name: PutBucketReferer

parameters.description_en: The container that stores the Referer configuration.

fields.description_en:
Specifies whether to allow requests with an empty Referer field to access OSS. Valid values:

- true (default): Requests with an empty Referer field are allowed to access OSS.
- false: Requests with an empty Referer field are not allowed to access OSS.
fields.description_zh:
指定是否允许Referer字段为空的请求访问OSS。取值如下：

- true（默认值）：允许Referer字段为空的请求访问OSS。
- false：不允许Referer字段为空的请求访问OSS。
fields.help_en:

fields.name: allow_empty_referer

fields.description_en:
Specifies whether to truncate the query string. Valid values:

- true (default): Truncates the query string.

- false: Does not truncate the query string.
fields.description_zh:
是否截断QueryString。

- true（默认值）：截断QueryString。

- false：不截断QueryString。

fields.description_en:
Specifies whether to truncate the path during matching (that is, only match the protocol://host/ part). Valid values:

- true: Truncates all parts of the URL after and including the path.

- false: Does not truncate any parts of the URL after and including the path.
fields.description_zh:
匹配时是否截断路径部分（即只匹配protocol://host/部分）。取值：

- true：截断URL中包括Path在内的后续所有部分。

- false：不截断URL中包括Path在内的后续所有部分。
fields.help_en:

fields.description_en:
The container that stores the Referer whitelist.
> **Note** PutBucketReferer uses overwrite semantics. The new whitelist specified in RefererList overwrites the existing whitelist. If you upload an empty RefererList (that is, it does not contain a Referer request element), this operation clears the existing whitelist in RefererList.
fields.description_zh:
保存Referer访问白名单的容器。
> **说明**PutBucketReferer为覆盖语义，即RefererList中的新指定的白名单列表将覆盖已配置的白名单列表。当您上传的RefererList为空时（即不包含Referer请求元素），此操作将清空RefererList中已配置的白名单列表。
